about: The prayer asks that Saint Venantius’s merits may make the offering acceptable to God. It then asks that the community, helped by the saint, may share in his glory.

seg.tr: Almighty God, may the merits of blessed Venantius make this offering acceptable to You, so that, supported by his help, we may be made sharers in his glory. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: we may be made sharers in his glory
who lives and reigns with You
in the unity of the Holy Spirit

ex.w007: The saint’s merits are asked to make the offering acceptable to God. The opening phrase names the offering that is to be accepted.
ex.w012: The emphatic pronoun refers to Venantius himself, whose help supports the community.
ex.w014: The people asking to share the saint’s glory are described as supported by him.
ex.w018: The community asks to be given a share in Venantius’s glory. The help received and the glory sought are distinct.
ex.w035: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
